# enums/enum

> Enumeration: enum Color(red, green, blue) declares numbered constants.

truck [enums](../enums.md) · [source](../../../registry/enums/enum.pkg)

```
enum Color(red, green, blue)

print green                 // 1
print Color_count           // 3
print Color_name(blue)      // blue
print Color_parse("red")    // 0
print Color_valid(7)        // false
```

Each name becomes a `const`, numbered from 0 in the order written. The
list may be spread over several lines, since it is in parentheses. It
also declares, named after the enumeration:

| declaration | is |
|---|---|
| `const <Name>_count` | how many names there are |
| `fn <Name>_name(v: int) -> str` | the name of a value, or `""` for a number that isn't one |
| `fn <Name>_parse(s: str) -> int` | the value with that name, or -1 |
| `fn <Name>_valid(v: int) -> bool` | is `v` one of the values |

Use it at the top level, like `const`; the names can be used anywhere in
the program, also before the enumeration. They are plain constants, so
two enumerations can't share a name. Combine with `stdx`'s `match`:

```
match c
case red, green
  print "warm-ish"
else
  print "cool"
end
```

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`; flags `top`

```
enum {name: ident} ( {first: ident} [ , {n: ident} ]* )
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | name | — |
| `first` | name | — |
| `n` (optional) | name | — |

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```
const {first} = 0
{each c in ,}
const {c.n} = {#c} + 1
{end}
const {cat name "_count"} = {#,} + 1
fn {cat name "_name"}({$v}: int) -> str
if {$v} == {first}
return {quote first}
end
{each c in ,}
if {$v} == {c.n}
return {quote c.n}
end
{end}
return ""
end
fn {cat name "_parse"}({$s}: str) -> int
if {$s} == {quote first}
return {first}
end
{each c in ,}
if {$s} == {quote c.n}
return {c.n}
end
{end}
return -1
end
fn {cat name "_valid"}({$v}: int) -> bool
return {$v} >= 0 && {$v} < {cat name "_count"}
end
```
